body.x: 247KOREA is planning to present ‘VOLT CASE’, an IOT smartphone case for self-protection, at CES 2018(Consumer Technology Show), the world largest IT technology held in Las Vegas, USA, from 9th January(Tue) to 12th January (Fri).

Supported by SeongNam Industry Promotion Agency, 247KOREA is able to present its product, ‘VOLT CASE’ which can be a regular smartphone case and a self-protection weapon in case of emergency. When activated, the linked APP is automatically executed and sent the location information and real-time video to the designated number. Moreover, an SOS notification message will be sent to notify emergency situation as well.

‘VOLT CASE’ stun gun delivers 30,000- volt shock and it will be produced as an IOT self-defense weapon linked with APP to prevent misuse and abuse. 247SOS self-defensive alarm with 100 alarm sounds will be released along with stun gun.

Compared to a regular electronic stun gun, it is relatively inexpensive. It is designed to be thin, light, and even colorful unlike regular stun guns. Produced as an IOT self-defense weapon, which is in tune with the times, the fact that a user can react to the emergency situation in smarter and faster way is the most distinctive feature.

SeongNam Industry Promotion Agency was established in 2001 to contribute to enhancing corporate management and reinforcing competitiveness through comprehensive and systematic supports for small and medium-sized enterprises as well as venture businesses. The agency plays roles in planning & researching for new business development; operating the business center and over-all supports including management/technology/information/foundation/labor force; discovering overseas market and supporting export business; carrying out investment and association of investment for corporate activities.

The world largest IT exhibition, CES, held every January by CTA (Consumer technology Association) is the place where you can feel the world trend in the electronics industry. AVING NEWS is the global news network which broadcasted news the most about the top 3 technology exhibitions: CES (Consumer Technology Show), MWC (Mobile World Congress), and IFA (International Funkausstellung Berlin) for the past 11 years and this time they will also send dispatch a special press to broadcast issues on global markets and introduce major corporates from Korea.
